name: Tritium DCFC Limited
summary: Tritium DCFC Limited, an Australian enterprise founded in 2001 and based in Murarrie, focuses on designing, manufacturing, and supplying direct current (DC) charging solutions for electric vehicles (EVs) worldwide. Their product range includes a variety of charging station hardware, encompassing both individual standalone units and integrated distributed chargers. Beyond physical hardware, the company provides an extensive service and maintenance program, offering product guarantees, formalized service level agreements, and sales of replacement parts. Tritium also manages a specialized software platform for service operations and enables high-power charging for EVs. Their broad customer base includes charge point operators, automotive manufacturers, electric vehicle fleet managers, conventional fuel stations, and businesses within the retail and utility industries.
